errors.text_span: след което през 2008 г. леко намалява до около 220
errors.evidence: The description states that the value in 2008 decreases to around 220. However, the chart shows that the value increases from 2007 (approx. 240) to 2008 (approx. 250), which is the local peak for that period. Both the trend (decrease) and the value (220) are incorrect.
The description states the value for 2009 is around 180, but the data point on the chart is visibly above the 200 line, at approximately 210.
The description claims the value for 2021 exceeds 600. The data point for 2021 is clearly below the 600 line on the y-axis, at approximately 580.
